message.content:
**Tesla Model S – India (estimated)**  

| Item | Approx. Cost (INR) |
|------|--------------------|
| Base Model S (Long‑Range) | ₹1.4 – 1.6 crore |
| Full Self‑Driving (FSD) package | +₹30 – 40 lakhs |
| Premium Interior / Upgrades | +₹10 – 20 lakhs |
| **Total (incl. FSD & upgrades)** | **₹1.8 – 2.0 crore** |

> **Why this estimate?**  
> • Tesla has **not yet launched** in India, so there is no official MSRP.  
> • The U.S. base price for a Model S Long‑Range is about **$90 k** (~₹7.2 lakh).  
> • Import duties on electric vehicles in India can be **≈ 100 %** (plus GST, state taxes, and handling fees), roughly **doubling** the cost.  
> • Adding the FSD package and optional upgrades pushes the price into the ₹1.8–2.0 crore range.

**Bottom line:** If Tesla were to enter India, you could expect a Model S to cost roughly **₹1.8–2.0 crore** (about **$240 k–$260 k**), but until an official launch, this remains a rough estimate.
